.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate
    :tickets: 1526

    Fixed bug in autogenerate rendering where a schema name passed as a
    SQLAlchemy ``quoted_name`` object with an explicit ``quote=True`` or
    ``quote=False`` setting would be rendered as a plain string literal,
    losing the explicit quoting preference. The rendered migration now
    preserves the ``quoted_name(...)`` wrapper in this case.
